Indicator: OC1: Number of policy or regulatory reforms adopted by APEC economies as a result of U.S. support
Data Source: Official government policies, regulations, or public announcements confirming reform adoption, supported by program activity documentation

Indicator: OC2: Percentage of APEC economies adopting U.S.-aligned governance frameworks or best practices
Data Source: Government policies, regulations, or official statements confirming adoption of U.S.-aligned frameworks or best practices

Indicator: OT1: Person hours of USG-supported training completed in trade and investment (EG.2-1)
Data Source: Training attendance records and training agendas

Disaggregates: U.S. FA objective; PSE modality; economy; workstream
Indicator: OT2: Number of USG engagements jointly undertaken with private sector enterprises (PSE-1)
Data Source: Engagement logs, meeting agendas, and documentation confirming joint activities with private sector partners

Indicator: OC3: Percentage of APEC initiatives under US APEC-RISE that resulted in participating APEC economies aligning policies or practices with U.S.-backed reforms.
Data Source: Program activity reports, government policy documents, and confirmation from participating economy representatives

Indicator: OT3: Number of US APEC-RISE initiatives referenced or reflected in official APEC policy documents, statements, or communiqués
Data Source: Official APEC policy documents, communiqués, meeting minutes, or program reports referencing program initiatives

Disaggregates: Business size; support type; opportunity type
Indicator: OC4: Percentage of U.S. private sector partners reporting U.S.-supported technical assistance expanded opportunities for business growth and market engagement in APEC economies
Data Source: Structured feedback or surveys from U.S. private sector partners participating in program activities

Disaggregates: Stakeholder type; connection type; economy; workstream
Indicator: OC5: Number of new connections or networks facilitated for the public or private sector through US APEC-RISE activities
Data Source: Event reports, meeting records, post-activity surveys, or documented introductions confirming new connections

Disaggregates: PSE type; PSE origin; PSE size; economy; workstream
Indicator: OT4: Number of private sector enterprises that engaged with the USG to support U.S. Foreign Assistance objectives (PSE-2)
Data Source: Engagement logs, meeting records, or program documentation confirming private sector collaboration

Disaggregates: Economy; institution type; input type; workstream
Indicator: OC6: Number of local institutions demonstrating continued use of U.S.-supported tools, technical knowledge, or practices
Data Source: Follow-up surveys, key informant interviews, monitoring visits, or institutional reports confirming sustained use

Disaggregates: Economy; barrier type; adaptive action type; workstream
Indicator: OC7: Percentage of identified barriers to reform adoption successfully resolved through adaptive actions
Data Source: Program records, reform tracking logs, stakeholder consultations, and documentation confirming barrier resolution

Disaggregates: Resource type; resource origin; objective addressed; economy; workstream
Indicator: OT5: Value of private sector resource commitments to support U.S. Foreign Assistance Objectives (PSE-4)
